name: HaluEval
intro: HaluEval 是一个包含 35,000 个样本的幻觉识别基准：30,000 个任务特定样本均分至问答、知识对话和摘要，另有 5,000 个来自 Alpaca 查询的通用样本。任务特定分支由 ChatGPT 生成并经事实增强过滤；通用分支则以响应分歧筛选难例并由人工标注幻觉类型与跨度。
org: Renmin University of China, Université de Montréal
build_method: ChatGPT 双策略生成、事实增强筛选、人工标注
eval_feature: 对抗性难例、任务特定与通用双分支、幻觉跨度标注
build_method_en: Two-strategy ChatGPT generation, ground-truth-enhanced filtering, human annotation
eval_feature_en: Adversarial hard cases, task-specific and general branches, hallucination-span labels
intro_en: HaluEval is a 35,000-sample hallucination-recognition benchmark: 30,000 task-specific samples evenly cover question answering, knowledge-grounded dialogue, and summarization, while 5,000 general samples come from Alpaca queries. ChatGPT generates task-specific hallucinations that are ground-truth-enhanced filtered; the general branch selects response-disagreement hard cases and adds human hallucination-type and span labels.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.11747. HaluEval contains exactly 35,000 samples: 10,000 each for QA from HotpotQA, knowledge-grounded dialogue from OpenDialKG, and summarization from CNN/DailyMail, plus 5,000 general Alpaca queries. For each task-specific seed, ChatGPT produces candidates through one-pass and conversational instruction learning with task-specific hallucination patterns; a ground-truth-enhanced ChatGPT filter keeps the most plausible difficult hallucinated counterpart paired with the normal answer. For general queries, three ChatGPT responses are sampled, average pairwise BERTScore identifies 5,000 low-similarity hard cases, and three qualified annotators per response label hallucination yes/no, affected spans, and unverifiable/nonfactual/irrelevant aspects. Thirty annotators participate; majority voting yields Fleiss' kappa 0.811, with 977 of 5,000 general samples labeled hallucinatory. Evaluation randomly presents a normal or hallucinated output and reports recognition accuracy for QA, dialogue, summarization, and general data.
